arguments.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS unlabelled_transactions FROM transactions t LEFT JOIN fraud_labels f ON f.transaction_id = CAST(t.id AS TEXT) WHERE f.transaction_id IS NULL
arguments.explanation: Counts transactions that have no matching row in fraud_labels, using a left join on the label key.
assumptions: 'No fraud label at all' means no row exists in fraud_labels for the transaction; a label of 0 counts as labelled, not unlabelled.
